decisions.reason: The enclosure assembly and drop-retention requirements do not change component sourceability, availability, or cost policies.
The source assigns secure retention to the enclosure but specifies no change to the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, or connector access.
The enclosure requirements do not alter the required sensor-board production files.
The source does not change manufacturer ordering, account setup, assembly settings, or order sequencing.
Easy enclosure assembly and physical component retention do not change BOM contents or assembly-part documentation.
The enclosure's drop-retention requirement does not alter the AXP2101 exposed-pad thermal function.
Although the enclosure must secure the battery and other components, the source specifies no change to battery-connector placement, orientation, clearance, or spacing.
The enclosure must retain the installed boards, but the source does not necessarily change the main board's dimensions, rail orientation, connector placement, or other PCB-layout constraints.
The source does not change the panel-mounted power button, its connector, signal connection, or control behavior.
The enclosure's retention obligation does not necessarily change the sensor board's rail orientation, connector placement, alignment, or cable-routing requirements.
